rules.loss: asset outstanding (dispatch to receipt, or to as-of date) longer than loss_threshold_days is LOST (MARK_LOST at dispatch+threshold, deposit forfeited)
rules.non_return: theft_risk_index*(0.5+site_risk)+noise > 0.4 or return would arrive after loss threshold
rules.repair: FAIL_REPAIRABLE -> REPAIR_SEND unless repairs >= max_repair_cycles (then SCRAP); post-repair score=0.45*score+noise must be < 0.4 else SCRAP
rules.deposit: CHARGE at dispatch; at intake inspection: LATE_FEE 2%/day of deposit capped at 50%, DAMAGE_DEDUCTION 15%(MINOR)/40%(MAJOR), DAMAGE_FORFEIT 100%(IRREPARABLE), remainder REFUNDED; LOSS_FORFEIT 100% on MARK_LOST
rules.dispute: delivery late > 72h => LATE_DELIVERY; transit damage score > 0.9 => CONDITION_MISMATCH; resolved after 3-30 days when before as-of date
